name: boiler_modulating_burner_refsim
title: Boiler with modulating burner: steady-state reference model
summary: Steady-state fuel-oil/gas boiler with a limited-modulating burner: combustion reference model (cpbar), gas-water and water-environment epsilon-NTU exchangers, four regimes (OFF, ON/OFF, modulating, full load) selected from the water set point. Native file blocked by CoolSolve gaps; a verified runnable variant resolves the regime branches for the stored operating point.

origin.course: ULiège model bank 2008-02-12, Heat and Cool Production Systems (reference simulation model)

verification.reference: EES stored solution of the source file (last run: ON/OFF regime at t_w_ex_set = 71 °C); it is the runnable variant boiler_modulating_burner_refsim_coolsolve that is verified
verification.notes: 43 common variables, 0 differ (rtol=0.001); maximum relative difference 2.25e-4 on Q_dot_u_FL (CoolProp vs EES mean specific heats of the combustion products at 1930 °C). Stale stored values of the module variables (a mix of an earlier MODULATING run, CS-BUG-EXTRACT-STALE) are skipped by name; the D10-renamed module internals were checked by hand against them (n exact, e/f_st ~5e-5, t_adiab 0.07 %).

related_external: ASHRAE TC4.7 HVAC1 Toolkit (J.P. Bourdouxhe, M. Grodent, J. Lebrun, C. Saavedra), cited by the original model

history.action: added (card C-158, MODULE flatten D10, cpbar from CSL-0005)
